steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.tunes: Two well-known tunes made only of steps. Sing them on “lah”, or on the note names if you know them.
steps.hotCrossBuns: “Hot Cross Buns”: listen, then sing it. The quick notes in the middle stay on the same note, then step up.
steps.odeToJoy: The first phrase of Beethoven’s “Ode to Joy”, singing along.
